address: 8 Soi Sukhumvit 33, Khlong Tan Nuea, Vadhana, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: This classic Thai house, painted in green with a lush front garden, offers an oasis in the city. Under Chef Chumpol's guidance, a skilled team led by a northern Thai head chef presents a menu preserving the traditional taste of northern Thailand. The lunch offers à la carte choices, while dinner features a seasonal set menu using ingredients from various regions. Highlights include the herb-packed Northern sharing set, Khan-Tok, and the flavourful Khao Soi....
